name: Ningguang
notes: A 4-star Geo main DPS whose damage is the Charged Attack with its Star Jades; every line scales with ATK (the 'check' line, Jade Screen's Skill DMG at 230%, is an ATK multiplier on the elemental curve). The sources differ on the talent: Game8 puts the Normal Attack first, then the Burst and the Skill; KQM puts the Burst first, then the Normal Attack level with the Skill. The card takes the Normal Attack as the damage talent, because the Charged Attack is the main hit, with the Burst second. They agree on 4pc Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods as best (Game8 names no other), ATK% Sands, a Geo DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet. The weapons differ: KQM's best is Cashflow Supervision, Game8's Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds; a third source (genshin.gg, 2026-10-30) also puts Lost Prayer first, then Kagura's Verity, Skyward Atlas, Memory of Dust and Solar Pearl, so that order is used with Cashflow Supervision third. genshin.gg's sets are 4pc Archaic Petra first (with Emblem of Severed Fate, Noblesse Oblige and Shimenawa's Reminiscence as 2pc partners), so Archaic Petra is added as the second set; its stats are ATK% Sands, Geo DMG Goblet and CRIT Circlet, as in the other two. The other sets are KQM's. Neither source gives stat goals; the only goal is ER, KQM's 110-130% for a Burst every 12s with one Skill and two or three other Geo units (110-140% in the other KQM teams).
